STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_013281.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_013281.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_013281 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 16,
    VALENCY = 2,
    GROUP = 4
) (
    input  [WIDTH:0] G,
    input  [WIDTH:0] P,
    output [WIDTH:0] Gi
);

  wire [WIDTH-1:0] g, p;

  assign Gi[0] = G[0];

  genvar i, j;
  generate
    for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + GROUP) begin : grp_PG
      if (i == 0) begin
        for (j = 1; j < GROUP; j = j + 1) begin : Initial_GC_gen
          Gray_cell #(VALENCY) GC_0 (
              {G[j], Gi[j-1]},
              P[j:j-1],
              Gi[j]
          );
        end
      end else begin
        for (j = i; j < i + GROUP; j = j + 1) begin : BC_GC_gen
          if (j == i) begin
            Gray_cell #(VALENCY) GC1 (
                {G[j], Gi[j-1]},
                P[j:j-1],
                Gi[j]
            );
            assign g[j] = G[j];
            assign p[j] = P[j];
          end else begin
            Black_cell #(VALENCY) BC2 (
                {G[j], g[j-1]},
                {P[j], p[j-1]},
                g[j],
                p[j]
            );
            Gray_cell #(VALENCY) GC2 (
                {g[j], Gi[i-1]},
                {p[j], 1'b0},
                Gi[j]
            );
          end
        end
      end
    end
  endgenerate
endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name autovcoder_013281.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
